producer_report.summary:
I added `crates/athena-core/tests/study_instance_split.rs` and recorded it as the OLY-B-S1-02 mechanism in `docs/spec.toml`. The measure ends `status: not shown`, because fresh context per instance and gap-fix-and-recheck can't be shown from static files. The new test target passes (12 tests), clippy is clean, and all of `cargo test -p xtask` passes, including the policy scan. I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`.
- **Instance check:** on the real tree, every `studies/<id>/` has no code files and has a `pin.json`.
- **Capability check:** nothing in `crates/athena-cap-study/src` or its `prompts/` names an instance. It matches only `studies/<id>` or the quoted id. A bare substring like `athena_core` doesn't trigger it.
- **Spec entry:** the real OLY-B-S1-02 entry has a mechanism, owner `Athena` and a measure. It is no longer in `spec_gaps`.
- **Negative tests:** a code file, a missing pin, a capability naming an instance, a measure without the label or command, a wrong owner, and mechanism `none`. Each produces a problem.
- **Mechanism text:** it also cites `StudyCapability::admit` and the per-instance conventions test, which already enforce the split. I cite them, not call them, because `athena-core` can't depend on the capability crate.
- **Data check:** it forbids code files rather than whitelisting json and md. `StudyCapability::admit` accepts nested paths and other file types, so a stricter check would reject trees it accepts.
- **Also changed:** `CHANGELOG.md` has a new entry. `xtask/shard-timings.txt` gets a line for the new test file, which the xtask timings test requires. I touched no governance files.

checks_run.note: all pass, including policy, ci_shards timings coverage and spec

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-S1-02 has mechanism naming crates/athena-core/tests/study_instance_split.rs (not "none"), owner "Athena", and a measure that names `cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split` and ends with `status: not shown`.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited the table in docs/spec.toml. Ran cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split: spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism passes. It asserts the mechanism path, owner, measure command and label.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/tests/study_instance_split.rs asserts on real files that every studies/<id>/ holds only data (json/md, no .rs) and has a pin.json, and that crates/athena-cap-study/src does not contain any studies/ instance id string.
criteria_check.evidence: Tests every_study_instance_holds_no_code_and_a_pin and the_study_capability_names_no_instance read the real tree and pass. Per the plan, the data rule forbids code files (a code-extension list) rather than whitelisting json/md, because StudyCapability::admit accepts other file types. The capability check matches `studies/<id>` and the quoted id, not a bare substring. It scans src/ and prompts/.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split`: passes on the change; its negative-case unit tests (an instance dir with a .rs file, a capability source naming an instance, a missing pin, a measure lacking the label) each produce a problem, so the test fails without the mechanism.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran the command: 12 passed. The negatives are an_instance_with_code_is_reported, a_capability_naming_an_instance_is_reported, an_instance_without_a_pin_is_reported, spec_check_refuses_a_wrong_status_label and spec_check_refuses_a_measure_without_the_command.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split`: the test also confirms the real OLY-B-S1-02 requirement no longer appears in spec_gaps (mechanism and measure present, measure_problem is None).
criteria_check.evidence: spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism asserts measure_problem is None and OLY-B-S1-02 is absent from spec_gaps; it passes. spec_check_refuses_a_none_mechanism shows mechanism none is a gap.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test pass on the final tree (Athena's recorded check on the same tree counts).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt, clippy (clean) and cargo test -p xtask (pass), but not the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gets a job entry; no other governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes.
criteria_check.evidence: Added one bullet under Unreleased/Added in CHANGELOG.md. Changed only the test file, docs/spec.toml, CHANGELOG.md and xtask/shard-timings.txt (a data file).

open_issues: xtask/shard-timings.txt is not a listed deliverable but needed a one-line addition so the xtask timings-coverage test passes; it is a data file, not governance.
I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`; I ran the athena-core target, clippy and all of xtask.
The test checks static structure only; fresh context per instance and gap-fix-and-recheck are not shown, so the measure ends `status: not shown`.
learnings: A new tests/*.rs file needs a line in xtask/shard-timings.txt or the xtask ci_shards test fails.
The producer Bash hook allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm; no pipes to tail or cd.
